author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**


GO:0034501 | protein localization to kinetochore | IBA with PTN002001209 , S000003061


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC1020.02

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Annotation. It isn't *incorrect* but localization terms that arren't transport aren't really describing the process, but are describing localization dependencies (phenotypes).

I annotated as

signaling adaptor activity
active form spc7 (Spc7/Phos-MELT) has_input(recruits) bub1, bub3, _part_of_ mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling _in_ outer kinetochore _during_ mitotic metaphase

which captures the process without using "protein localization" terms.

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue: GO:0034501 | protein localization to kinetochore | IBA with PTN002001209
